title: Light Fluffy Croatian Veal Skewers
description: A floral and adventurous Croatian dish featuring veal, shio-koji-cure, and jain-friendly ingredients, perfect for a unique dinner experience. The combination of veal, spices, and floral notes creates a truly special flavor profile.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together shio-koji, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, rosemary, salt, and black pepper.
Add the veal cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the veal cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the veal is cooked through.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional rosemary if desired.
Refrigerate any leftovers promptly and consume within 3 days.
